body:
Founder feedback on the first observation-vector pass, fully addressed.

Checked directly against packages/common/physics.h before building anything:
ability_cooldown is ONE shared timer gating FOUR abilities (AR/shotgun
ability, katana dash, sniper storm activation) -- activating any one blocks
every other one until it reaches 0. storm_charges is a genuinely separate,
persistent resource that survives independently of that shared cooldown --
confirmed the founder's own described sequence (activate storm, let the
shared cooldown expire, dash on weapon 6, still have unfired storm rounds
banked) is exactly this real mechanic.

Added reload_timer + ability_cooldown to the wire protocol (NetPlayer grew
64->68 bytes, re-verified via a compiled sizeof/offsetof probe). Fixed
SelfIsShooting/SelfCrouching (real outbound state, no server round-trip
needed) and SelfStormChargesFrac (was fabricated to 0). Added a real AABB
raycast (geometry.go) against the QUEUE level's own fetched box list --
5 new wall/floor distance features, closing the "no raycast" gap.

ObservationSize: 72 -> 84. Round-timer wire-field gap left open per the
founder's own explicit "not sure about the round trip timer thing."

11 unit tests total (up from 7), full go test ./... green, live 2-bot UDP
test against the extended 68-byte wire format with no panics, live server +
bot pool + fresh Windows client redeployed.

Commit: SHANKPIT@1c16348. Doc: docs/BOT_TRAINING_NORTHSTAR.md §7-8.

⚓ ☃
